en.no_max_sanity: Not another one! My head's spinning as it is.

en.shadow_other: Not one of mine. Whose is it? Never mind, no time!

pt.codex: Hm. Umas mãos a mais me poupariam um tempão.

pt.no_max_sanity: Mais uma não! Minha cabeça já está girando.

ru.no_max_sanity: Только не еще одну! У меня и так голова кругом.
ru.shadow_mine: Наконец-то хоть одна версия меня делает, что ей велят!

zh.no_max_sanity: Can't have one more! My head is dizzy enough already.

zh.shadow_other: This one isn't mine. Whose is it? Forget it, no time!

ru.codex: Hmm. Spare hands would save me heaps of time.

ru.no_max_sanity: Not one more! My head's in a whirl as it is.

voice_notes: Wanda is brisk, impatient and practical: everything is measured in time saved or lost, she swears with 'Oh botheration', reaches for clockwork metaphors ('a clock that's been left unwound', 'tick-tock'), jokes about other timelines, and treats shadow magic matter-of-factly ('Shadow magic's just a tool, like anything else'; nightmare fuel is 'A necessary evil') while still panicking when things get out of hand. PT-BR renders her as informal and quick ('pra', 'dar o fora', 'bater pato'), with 'Ai, que amolação' for botheration and 'relógio sem corda' for an unwound clock. ZH gives her sentence-final 呐/呀 and 嗷，麻烦呐 for botheration, with clock vocabulary like 没上发条的钟 and 松发条. RU uses feminine forms, 'Вот ведь неудобство' for botheration, 'Хм-м.' for her vanilla Codex line, and clock idioms such as 'Часики тикают' and 'часы, которые забыли завести'.

line_notes.codex: Keeps her vanilla 'Hm.' and turns it into her pragmatic, time-obsessed reason to use the book: servants mean saved time, which is the same attitude she shows toward the Shadow Forge.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: Her signature 'Oh botheration' plus the clockmaker's metaphor of a mechanism winding down, echoing her watch-depleted line about needing more dark fuel.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: A short, flustered refusal in her exclamatory panic register that clearly reads as 'my mind can't take another one right now'.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Plays on her timeline lore (she has met other versions of herself and everyone else) and her bossy impatience: the shadow copy is the first 'me' that obeys.
line_notes.shadow_other: She notices it isn't hers, starts to wonder whose it is, then waves it off because she never has time.
